scripts.build: pnpm --filter @story-pilot/contracts build && pnpm --filter @story-pilot/domain build && pnpm --filter @story-pilot/db build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @story-pilot/contracts build && pnpm --filter @story-pilot/domain build && pnpm --filter @story-pilot/db build && tsx src/main.ts
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @story-pilot/contracts build && pnpm --filter @story-pilot/domain build && pnpm --filter @story-pilot/db build && vitest run src
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @story-pilot/contracts build && pnpm --filter @story-pilot/domain build && pnpm --filter @story-pilot/db build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
